title: Reparenting `VisibleOnScreenNotifier3D` breaks it
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproduced in 4.8-dev4 and 4.7.1

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Direct3D 12 (Forward+)

### Issue description

Reparenting a `VisibleOnScreenNotifier3D` node (or any of its ancestors) to a different node (independent of node type, reproducible with `Node` and `Node3D`), then immediately reparenting it back to its original parent breaks the notifier, causing it to always return `false` to `IsOnScreen` queries (even though it continuously is on screen).

It is possible to restore the correct behavior by setting the visibility of the notifier to false, waiting until a frame is rendered and then making it visible again.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Reparent `VisibleOnScreenNotifier3D` to a different node
2. Reparent it back to its original parent
3. Observe broken `IsOnScreen` behavior
4. Toggle its visibility to off and back on to restore correct functionality

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[visibility-on-screen-notifier-repro.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31596908/visibility-on-screen-notifier-repro.zip)
Current state of the notifier is continuously printed to the console.
Use the right arrow to trigger the bug.
Use the up arrow to restore correct behavior (may need to be pressed more than once if unlucky timing causes no frame to be rendered inbetween the press and the next physics update)
